ideas.pitch: A mobile computer vision app that automatically detects road defects and civic infrastructure damage from a mounted smartphone camera and logs them for municipal action.
ideas.problem_statement: Sustainability & Social Impact track: Addressing urban infrastructure and civic management challenges in Bengaluru.
ideas.title: Bengaluru Pothole & Civic Eye Inspector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a proven computer vision inspection pattern from railway and industrial monitoring wins, delivering clear, quantified municipal impact that appeals directly to judges looking for local social utility.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered offline-first agricultural assistant that diagnoses crop diseases from leaf photographs and provides local market pricing via SMS and voice in Kannada.
ideas.problem_statement: AI/ML & Generative AI track: Building practical generative AI and computer vision applications for rural and agricultural upliftment.
ideas.title: Kannada AgriDoctor & Market Link
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly builds upon the success of Udaya 1.0 winners by combining crop disease detection with localized language accessibility, guaranteeing high relevance to the Dayananda Sagar organizing committee.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight voice-first AI agent that intercepts suspicious phone calls in local languages and alerts elderly family members or designated guardians before financial fraud occurs.
ideas.problem_statement: AI/ML & Generative AI track: Developing agentic AI solutions that solve critical human vulnerability and safety issues.
ideas.title: VridhaGuard Voice Scam Shield
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the architectural success of agentic voice assistants that protect vulnerable populations, providing a deeply emotional and technically impressive demo in a 12-hour window.

ideas.pitch: A community-driven delivery coordination app that groups nearby errands and neighborhood deliveries into low-emission walking or cycling routes using volunteer groups.
ideas.problem_statement: Sustainability & Social Impact track: Reducing carbon footprints and fostering community collaboration for hyper-local logistics.
ideas.title: LocalLoop Hyper-Local Eco-Rider
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on community coordination with a clear carbon-saving metric, aligning with judges' preference for quantifiable environmental benefits demonstrated via a live map interface.

ideas.pitch: An open innovation IoT dashboard that aggregates real-time power consumption data across institutional buildings and gamifies energy saving targets for student departments.
ideas.problem_statement: Open Innovation track: Building creative smart-campus solutions using IoT data streams and collaborative software.
ideas.title: CampusPlug Open Energy Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the Open Innovation track perfectly by providing an instantly deployable dashboard for educational campuses, maximizing local utility and immediate live-demo feasibility.
